market.verdict: On 2735 bouts with prices (2014-2020), the model's log loss 0.6620 is worse than the market's 0.6180 (gap +0.0440, 95% CI 0.0310 to 0.0566; positive means worse). Blending the model into the price changed log loss by -0.0004 [-0.0022, 0.0014] versus the raw price, and by -0.0007 [-0.0023, 0.0009] versus the price recalibrated on the same earlier years, so the model does not demonstrably add information beyond the price.
caveats: The dataset does not say which bookmaker, or whether the price is opening, closing or best-available. Treat it as an as-recorded market price, not a verified closing line.
Coverage ends March 2020 and only 2014 onward overlaps the model test years, so the comparison does not cover the last six years.
A model that matches the market on log loss still cannot profit after the margin; beating the market needs a consistent, significant gap in the model’s favour.
Matching is by date and fighter name; bouts that could not be matched are excluded, which may bias the sample toward well-known fighters.
